title: Rebuilding AT Creations: a bilingual catalogue in Go and SvelteKit
excerpt: I rewrote a bilingual (English/Vietnamese) shop catalogue from Express to a Go API, a SvelteKit storefront and a SvelteKit admin, with security fixed by design.
